messages:
Sam Chan: Running the int4 shadow on 5% traffic for model-v3 -> model-v3-int4. quick sanity: latency good, cost down ~38% but saw some signal on the semantic QA eval.
Anjali Rao: Can you paste the failure modes? short summary pls.
Sam Chan: Per-ctx QA critical_f1 dropped 3.4% absolute on the guided prompts set (our critical path). KL divergence across answer-token distributions = 0.15. paired t-test p=0.02 vs baseline. Not huge on avg BLEU/perplexity though.
PJ: Hmm that's above our soft threshold. What's our current auto-fallback rule? I thought we were at 5% abs drop.
Elaine: Current policy: auto-fallback if any critical eval sees >=4% absolute drop OR p<0.01. That's why this didn't auto-fallback. But p=0.02 still concerning.
Sam Chan: Right. But this is concentrated on the few-shot guided templates (20% of traffic). Shadow logs show divergences when prompt includes <instruction> + example pairs. Might be quant-induced tokenization probs.
Anjali Rao: Do we have per-user impact? Are we surface-level hallucinations or precision loss? need examples.
Sam Chan: Quick examples: before -> "John sold the car in 2018"; int4 -> adds extraneous mention of lease. So precision/extra-entity hallucinations.
PJ: Deploy-bot, can you attach the snapshot and delta eval table?
deploy-bot: Canary run complete: 5% shadow snapshot uploaded: https://redwood/internal/canary/2067890123/results. Summary CSV + diffs.
eval-bot: Summaries: critical_f1 baseline=0.892, int4=0.858, delta=-0.034; KL_cat=0.15; p_pairwise=0.02; sample_count=4.2k.
Elaine: We should tighten auto-fallback to catch this class. Proposal: auto-fallback if any critical eval drop >=3% abs OR KL>0.12 OR p<0.05 on paired metric for critical sets. Also add per-template hysteresis (need 2 sequential canaries failing) to avoid oscillation.
Anjali Rao: I like adding KL and p-value. But 2 sequential failures might delay rollback on real regressions. Suggest: immediate rollback if drop >=5% OR KL>0.2 OR hallucination alert count > 50, else require 2 canaries for 3-5% range.
Sam Chan: Agreed. Draft rollout config (for ops):
```
rollout:
  phase: canary
  canary_frac: 0.05
  eval_sets:
    - critical_guided_fewshot
    - extraction_schema_tests
  metrics:
    - name: critical_f1
      auto_fallback_abs_drop: 0.03
    - name: kl_answer_dist
      auto_fallback_threshold: 0.12
    - name: p_pairwise
      auto_fallback_threshold: 0.05
  hysteresis:
    sequential_failures_required: 2
    immediate_override_thresholds:
      critical_f1: 0.05
      kl_answer_dist: 0.2
      hallucination_count: 50
  auto_fallback: true
```
PJ: Can ops/infra add a quick flag to disable hysteresis for high-severity customers? We need a fast path.
Elaine: Yep, add tenant_override: true with admin auth. Also add an incident tag if auto-fallback triggers.
Anjali Rao: Action items: Sam collect 50 more labeled examples of the hallucination pattern; PJ update rollout config in the repo and add tests; Elaine update policy doc + incident playbook; I'll run an extra-shadow with bloom-filtered prompts to isolate tokenization issues.
Sam Chan: On it. Will post sample diffs and small reproducer by EOD. Thanks :thumbsup:
PJ: Thx — loop back after the reproducer. If reproducer shows tokenization edgecases, we might try per-layer clamp or calibration before dropping quant.
deploy-bot: Note: rollback will be automatic if any immediate_override_thresholds breached. Logged event id: rb-2067890123.
